The strongest honest case here is thin, and I don't think it clears the bar.

The brief shows some live activity: 33 buyers and 16 sellers in the last 15 minutes, $3,029 volume, and a net inflow of 17.57 SOL, with a flat-to-slightly-positive 30-minute return. Nothing shows a dump, and the sell-to-buy ratio on the first two minutes after graduation is zero.

But the structure cuts against it. The coin is classed OPERATOR, with bundle share and top-3 share both at 1.0, and 15 buyers in the first two minutes after graduation supplied roughly 5,010 SOL, with the top five buyers taking 99.98% of that. That is the concentrated, pre-positioned pattern that precedes the sell-off, not organic demand. The recent 15-minute net flow is a small fraction of the early operator money, so it cannot show that outside buyers are absorbing the supply. Market cap of about $179M against $3K of volume also suggests a valuation far out of line with actual trading.

Against a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost and a base rate near break-even for operator coins, I see no evidence that demand will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. My recommendation is to skip.
